purpose: Original transparent raster artwork for existing vehicle and helicopter classes. Five authored headings plus mirroring resolve eight screen directions. Independent animated rotor and turret layers.

prompts.light: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent RGBA vehicle sprite atlas for the illustrated isometric forest strategy game Apes Together Strong. Create a wide 2560 x 2048 transparent image with EXACTLY 5 equal columns and 4 equal rows, 20 separate full vehicle sprites. Same illustrated semi-realistic hand-painted strategy-game style: muted olive drab, charcoal tires, cool upper-left lighting, warm worn metal edges, dirt and scratches, rich detailed readable forms. No text, labels, shadows, terrain or backgrounds. Each sprite stays wholly inside its cell with at least 8% empty margins, entire wheels and antennas visible, consistent elevated 30-degree camera, same scale within each row. The FIVE COLUMNS are exact screen-facing directions: (1) FRONT facing straight DOWN screen, (2) front three-quarter facing DOWN-RIGHT, (3) SIDE facing directly RIGHT screen, (4) rear three-quarter facing UP-RIGHT, (5) REAR facing straight UP screen. Maintain each vehicle's design across all five directions. Row 1: compact four-wheel military scout jeep, open passenger area, spare tire, roll bars, glass windshield, grille, headlights. Row 2: enclosed command utility 4x4 with radio aerials, enclosed roof, rear communications boxes and spare tire, pale brass unit stripes. Row 3: imposing 6-wheel troop transport truck with khaki canvas cargo canopy, metal cab, realistic windows, steps and exhaust. Row 4: four-wheel armored patrol car with sloped angular steel armor, turret hatch, heavy tires, cool dark forest-green paint. All are detailed actual original artwork, never geometric icons. Transparent background, no contact shadow. Precisely 4 rows and 5 columns.

prompts.turret: Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent game sprite atlas of separate military TURRETS, no chassis or tank bodies. EXACTLY FIVE columns and FIVE rows, 25 separated sprites with clear empty transparent margins. Each cell contains ONLY one complete turret including cannon barrel, centered on its circular lower swivel ring, using elevated 30-degree isometric game camera. The 5 columns are: (1) gun pointing straight DOWN screen, front view; (2) gun pointing diagonally DOWN-RIGHT screen, three-quarter front; (3) gun pointing RIGHT screen, side view; (4) gun pointing UP-RIGHT screen, three-quarter rear; (5) gun pointing straight UP screen, rear view. Every row repeats the same design in those five views. Row 1: compact IFV auto-cannon turret with thin medium barrel and angular armor, olive-green. Row 2: main battle tank turret with long single large barrel, hatches, worn rivets, green armor. Row 3: teal-green twin-barrel burst tank turret, two parallel cannons, rectangular reinforced mantlet. Row 4: ochre self-propelled mortar turret, three short wide tubes tilted upward in armored rack. Row 5: slate-blue rotary tank turret, large 6-barrel minigun cluster. Rich detailed semi-realistic hand-painted 2D strategy-game artwork, not icons, muted colors, cool upper-left light and bright worn edges. Actual transparent RGBA background with zero alpha between sprites. NO colored or grey background, no shadow, no environment, no smoke, no text, no labels, no number, no bounding boxes. Make the barrels and swivel rings complete with no clipping or overlapping cells. Exactly 5 x 5 grid.
prompts.heli: Use case: stylized-concept. Original transparent RGBA layered HELICOPTER sprite atlas for hand-painted semi-realistic isometric forest strategy game. Exactly 5 columns and 4 rows. Transparent background with zero alpha between all sprites. No environment, ground, shadows, labels or text. Rich detailed artwork of worn military metal, intricate glazed cockpit, doors, rivets, tail boom, skids, rotor mast, muted olive green and cool gray, cool upper-left light. FIRST THREE ROWS: five views of same helicopter across columns. Columns (1) nose straight DOWN screen front view, (2) nose diagonally DOWN-RIGHT, (3) nose directly RIGHT side view, (4) nose diagonally UP-RIGHT rear view, (5) nose straight UP rear view. Elevated 30-degree camera. Row1 light recon helicopter with bulbous glass cockpit, narrow tail and landing skids, no weapons. Row2 armed scout helicopter with compact fuselage, short weapon mounts and skid landing gear. Row3 large assault gunship with narrow armored cockpit, missile pods, heavy gun mount and strong tail. Important ALL helicopter bodies in rows1-3 have a visible central rotor MAST but NO MAIN ROTOR BLADES and NO TAIL ROTOR BLADES; those get animated separately. Entire tail and skids inside each cell, consistent scale within each row, 12% transparent margins. ROW4 is five separated COMPONENTS for animation: column1 top-view isolated four-blade main rotor with hub, blades forming plus shape; column2 same top-view rotor blades rotated 22 degrees; column3 same rotor with semi-transparent fast circular motion blur; column4 separate small tail rotor with 4 blades and hub front-on; column5 same tail rotor blades rotated 45 degrees with soft motion blur. All components are detailed metal illustrations on actual transparent background, no backdrop. Main rotors drawn from DIRECTLY ABOVE as flat discs so engine can foreshorten them. Exact 5 x 4 grid, no clipping, no overlap. Emphasize distinct silhouettes for each class.
